name: Forsta (Press Ganey Forsta, now part of Qualtrics)
oneLiner: Enterprise survey, market research and customer experience platform (the HX Platform), formed from Confirmit and FocusVision, owned by Press Ganey since 2022 and by Qualtrics since May 2026.
bestFor: Large enterprises that run research-grade CX and market research programs; a weak fit for most restaurant operators, especially now that it is being folded into Qualtrics.

updates.text: Added new Forsta AI capabilities to the HX Platform and AI agents in Research HX.
Press Ganey Forsta acquired InMoment, a CX and review-management company.
Qualtrics completed its $6.75 billion acquisition of Press Ganey Forsta, agreed in October 2025.

features: Advanced survey design with complex logic, quotas and multilingual surveys
Feedback collection across email, SMS, web, QR code and other channels
AI text analytics that groups open-ended answers into themes
Transactional and relationship CX programs alongside market research in one platform
Qualitative research tools (focus groups, interviews) integrated into the HX Platform
notes: Ownership chain: Confirmit + FocusVision formed Forsta (2021); Press Ganey acquired Forsta (2022, renamed Press Ganey Forsta / PG Forsta); Qualtrics agreed to acquire PG Forsta on Oct 6 2025 (https://qualtrics.com/news/qualtrics-to-invest-6-75-billion-in-press-ganey-forsta-acquisition-to-advance-ai-powered-experience-management) and closed around May 19 2026. Forrester expects Qualtrics to fold PG Forsta and InMoment components into its platform over time, so the Forsta brand's future is uncertain; forsta.com content now partly lives under pressganey.com/forsta-legacy. No named restaurant customer found (Forsta says it serves restaurant clients in general). Tecan (life sciences) and Amadeus (travel) are the only named customers with sources. PG Forsta was a Leader in the 2025 Gartner Magic Quadrant for VoC Platforms. Consider replacing this pick or pointing to the Qualtrics entry (qualtrics-xm.json / qualtrics.json exist).
